description: Parse a multipart body into an ordered tuple of parts. The boundary is taken from the content-type parameters (case-insensitively). Each part exposes its headers (preserving order) and its raw content with the leading/trailing boundary framing and the header/body separator removed; a part with no headers yields an empty header set. Content that spans multiple lines is preserved verbatim.

input.content:
--samp1
Header-1: Header-Value-1
Header-2: Header-Value-2

Body 1, Line 1
Body 1, Line 2
--samp1

Body 2, Line 1
--samp1--

cases.expected_output:
parts=2
part0.header.Header-1=Header-Value-1
part0.header.Header-2=Header-Value-2
part0.content=Body 1, Line 1
Body 1, Line 2
part1.content=Body 2, Line 1

input.content:
--samp1
Header-1: Header-Value-1
Header-2: Header-Value-2

Body 1, Line 1
Body 1, Line 2
--samp1

Body 2, Line 1
--samp1--

cases.expected_output:
parts=2
part0.header.Header-1=Header-Value-1
part0.header.Header-2=Header-Value-2
part0.content=Body 1, Line 1
Body 1, Line 2
part1.content=Body 2, Line 1

input.content:
--test boundary
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="field 1"

value 1
--test boundary
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="field 2"

value 2
--test boundary
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="field 3"

value 3
--test boundary
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="field 4"

value 4
--test boundary--

cases.expected_output:
parts=4
part0.header.Content-Disposition=form-data; name="field 1"
part0.content=value 1
part1.header.Content-Disposition=form-data; name="field 2"
part1.content=value 2
part2.header.Content-Disposition=form-data; name="field 3"
part2.content=value 3
part3.header.Content-Disposition=form-data; name="field 4"
part3.content=value 4
